svg.aria-label: Hi, I'm Vlad. Role: Software Engineer; Approach: Agent-first, spec-driven; Coding: since 14; OS: macOS · Linux · Windows. I own the spec and the verification, agents write the code. I start from what users and the business actually need, and I treat every business I work with as my own. The desire to speed up routine work pushed me to learn programming, but after diving into this field I realized that I don't want to do anything else :)
